title: VTC Notifications — List — payload
description: An administrator with `vtc.notifications.read` lists the notifications the community holds as their addressee — filtered by kind or holder — with, for each, whether the community may relay it, what a relay of it would disclose, and the relay decisions already made (VTI-NTF-070). Lapsed notifications are left out unless asked for. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

heldBy.description: Only notifications whose thing is held by this DID — for example, one community's elections.

includeLapsed.description: Also return notifications that are withdrawn, or whose `validUntil` has passed, and that the community still holds. Absent or false: only notifications whose thing can still be acted on.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same filters. The community refuses one it did not issue.

Response.title: VTC Notifications — List — response payload
Response.description: One page of the received notifications that match, most recently received first.

nextCursor.description: Present when more items remain; absent on the last page.
